study: The date of an arXiv Physics announcement and the version available to readers

registered.editorial_selection: The highest and lowest announcement-arm ranks whose complete supporting-paper set had no exact match in the submission arm on the same issue date.

method.submission_arm: Each UTC submission day in the seven-day window was queried independently against the 18 configured subjects using submittedDate. Versions reflect the live API on November 20, 2026.
method.announcement_arm: Read every date and page of the native grp_physics list. Count new, cross-listed and replacement sections. Keep each identifier at its first new or cross-list entry in the window. Load its v1 title, abstract and category tags directly from the Atom API. Apply the 18 subjects to that version. A Physics cross-list can follow an earlier public release elsewhere.
method.source_checks: An independent HTML DOM parser enumerated the official lists. Versioned Atom ID batches, eight native subject lists and the subsequent available mailing days provided cross-checks. For each weekly arm, hash sorted bare identifiers separated by newlines with a final newline. Provenance digests include the identifier, listed day, versioned identifier and a SHA-256 of the whitespace-normalized title, newline and abstract. Dates are the source’s UTC calendar labels.
method.landing_sample: For one announcement-only paper and one shared paper with a later revised title or abstract in each week, choose the lexicographically smallest SHA-256 of the week ending, one space and the bare arXiv ID. Add the predeclared molecular-lattice control. Compare the title, abstract and first submission date with each v1 landing page. Three pages spell Greek symbols with TeX commands where the Atom feed uses Unicode.
method.revision_check: For every shared paper with differing texts and a latest version submitted after cutoff, obtain intermediate Atom versions. Compare the last version submitted by the cutoff against the latest version retrieved on November 20. This checks the introduction of later wording. It does not establish the announcement date of every individual revision.
method.observation_limits: The catchup form currently accepts the past 90 days. July queries returned HTTP 400. To trace late announcements, check up to seven following days, through November 20 at the latest. A missing match in that interval leaves the actual date open. The trial deliberately fixes version 1 even when a later revision was available during the window.

manifest.unit: One arXiv identifier per UTC comparison week in either collection. Empty cells mean the paper was absent from that collection. The mailing arm uses v1 throughout. A shared paper is compared after collapsing whitespace in both titles and abstracts.

editorial_checks.finding: Seven papers calculate shadow observables for specified black-hole metrics. The two studies of individual parameters are correctly described. The brief’s count misses joint constraints in a third EHT comparison. Its table holds the other parameters fixed. Two papers share an author, as the detailed summary discloses.

All three theoretical studies test how an alternative early thermal history changes the parameters required for the observed dark-matter abundance. The full freeze-in study also confirms larger Yukawa couplings. The brief correctly gives the opposite direction for the dark-photon portal’s kinetic mixing and identifies the enhanced annihilation needed after late particle injection.

The five Euclid DR1 companion papers validate astrometric or photometric performance against reference observations and mission requirements. The quoted VIS and NISP precision, ground-based photometry thresholds, outstanding calibrations and COSMOS reference-model limits agree with the source results. The copy explicitly identifies the common release.

editorial_checks.disposition: Withdraw the ranked group and retain its position and reason
editorial_checks.finding: The detailed copy describes genuine individual results. Memory dimension, entropy production and the size of a classical message alphabet are different resources. The limiting comparisons also differ. There is no single tested resource or common asymptotic result across the three papers.

public_decision: Use these public-mailing dates and versioned links for further historical expanded Physics trials. Expanded Physics continues on demand. The registered independent high-, low- and excluded-group editorial review and 14 genuine shared live operating dates remain conditions for scheduling. The owner will select the service-wide model budget after measurement.
interpretation: A ranked group match requires identical paper membership. Model review, clustering inputs and downstream summaries may differ between independent runs. Groups containing an absent paper cannot be reproduced intact from the other collection. Counts with identical underlying source texts describe the limit of direct attribution to changed papers. Charges are the recorded model ledger for each new snapshot. The two source-preserving September retries are reported separately. The three audit reruns only rendered stored results and used no model calls. The November first-version NISP paper had an enrichment fallback. Its reported performance was independently verified in the upper-rank review.
